symbols.name: browse
symbols.summary: Inventory listing card with quick-open actions for individual SKUs.
symbols.prose:
The browse card demonstrates a table-heavy ui.card.v1 screen. It renders all inventory rows and a
secondary quick-open action column for jumping into item detail.

symbols.name: home
symbols.summary: Inventory landing card with quick links into the main inventory workflows.
symbols.prose:
The home card is the entry point for the inventory stack. It demonstrates a simple navigation card
built entirely from text and button primitives.

symbols.name: itemDetail
symbols.summary: Editable item detail card with quantity deltas and draft-backed form state.
symbols.prose:
The itemDetail card is the main editable form example in the inventory stack. It demonstrates
draft-backed field editing, optimistic quantity delta actions, and destructive item removal.

symbols.name: lowStock
symbols.summary: Threshold-based inventory triage view for low or empty stock.
symbols.prose:
The lowStock card filters inventory rows against the active threshold and demonstrates a simple
alert-style workflow with mock supplier and print actions.

symbols.name: newItem
symbols.summary: Creation form for adding a new inventory item.
symbols.prose:
The newItem card demonstrates a full create flow with validation, draft state, and success
notifications using the ui.card.v1 primitives.

symbols.name: priceCheck
symbols.summary: Single-field lookup card for checking current price and stock.
symbols.prose:
The priceCheck card is the smallest form example in the inventory stack. It shows how a simple
lookup flow can still use the same draft/result pattern as larger cards.

symbols.name: receive
symbols.summary: Receiving workflow for adding stock back into inventory.
symbols.prose:
The receive card is a compact form workflow for stock intake. It demonstrates draft-backed form
state and a simple success/error result badge.

symbols.name: report
symbols.summary: Derived metrics report card for the inventory and sales slices.
symbols.prose:
The report card demonstrates a read-only summary card built from derived metrics rather than raw
records. It is useful as a compact example of a reporting-style ui.card.v1 page.

symbols.name: salesToday
symbols.summary: Sales log card that summarizes recent orders and links back to sold inventory items.
symbols.prose:
The salesToday card shows how a ui.card.v1 card can render derived totals alongside a table and a
secondary navigation list.
